title: Fix leaderboard weekly/monthly time filtering using user-selected result date timestamps

requirements.text:
Update backend leaderboard timeframe filtering so that:
- Weekly leaderboard shows only results from the last 7 days.
- Monthly leaderboard shows only results from the last 30 days.
- The date the user selected when recording a win/loss is the date used for timeframe inclusion.
- The returned leaderboard totals (wins/losses/totalGames/streak/score ordering) reflect only results inside the selected timeframe (not all-time totals).

quotes:
1)last 7 days for weekly and last 30 days for monthly
2)use selected date to generate timestamp for filtering
3)only results from selected filter

acceptanceCriteria: Calling getLeaderboard("weekly") only counts wins/losses whose recorded result date falls within the last 7 days (inclusive of today).
Calling getLeaderboard("monthly") only counts wins/losses whose recorded result date falls within the last 30 days (inclusive of today).
Calling getLeaderboard("all") continues to return all-time totals.
Filtering does not rely on comparing a YYYYMMDD day ID to an epoch-days value; timeframe inclusion is computed using consistent date/timestamp representations.
Leaderboard ordering remains consistent with existing score comparator (score desc, then wins desc).

requirements.text:
Store and use a discrete timestamp derived from the user-selected result date when recording wins/losses so timeframe filtering is accurate.
- When a win/loss is recorded for a selected day, persist a timestamp representation for that result date that can be compared to 'now' to compute last-7-days/last-30-days windows.
- Ensure decrement/remove operations continue to work correctly with the new stored representation.

quotes: Is there a way we can filter by making a discrete timestamp when users add wins and losses? They already have to select the date when they add results so would this help with the filtering feature?
use selected date to generate timestamp for filtering

acceptanceCriteria: Recording a win/loss persists enough information to accurately determine whether that result falls within the last 7/30 days at query time.
Removing (decrementing) a win/loss for a day updates the stored data and the affected leaderboard timeframes correctly.
No regressions to the existing rule that users can only record results on days they have marked as available.

requirements.text: Add any necessary Motoko state migration for existing stored match results so existing daily logs continue to be readable and leaderboard queries do not trap after upgrade.
acceptanceCriteria: Upgrading the canister preserves existing recorded wins/losses and they still appear in the all-time leaderboard after deployment.
Leaderboard queries (weekly/monthly/all) succeed after upgrade without traps caused by incompatible stored types.
Migration is only introduced if required by the chosen state representation change (e.g., if a stored type changes).

requirements.text: Ensure the frontend leaderboard filters (Weekly/Monthly/All Time) display rankings that match the corrected backend timeframe logic, without requiring changes to the user’s flow for selecting a date and recording/removing wins/losses.

quotes: 1)last 7 days for weekly and last 30 days for monthly

acceptanceCriteria: Switching between Weekly/Monthly/All Time updates the leaderboard table to show only results within that timeframe (or all-time).
The 'Select a date to record results' control continues to work as-is (user selects a date; wins/losses can be added/removed for that date).
The timeframe label/range display in the leaderboard UI remains coherent with the meaning of weekly=last 7 days and monthly=last 30 days.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo (no additional backend services).
Use English for any user-facing text.

Do not edit frontend immutable paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
nonGoals: Do not add new leaderboard filter types beyond weekly/monthly/all.
Do not change the scoring formula or ranking tie-break rules (beyond making timeframe filtering correct).
Do not add third-party analytics, external databases, or real-time/WebSocket features.
